title: Unique path matching an input
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\alpha$ be a type, let $T$ be a decision tree on $n$ coordinates with outputs in $\alpha$, and let $x\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$. There is exactly one path in the list of paths of $T$ whose prescribed coordinate values all agree with $x$.
